EXACT SKETCH-LINES-TO-REALITY TRANSFORMATION — IMAGE-TO-VIDEO.

CORE RULE: DO NOT DESIGN A NEW CHARACTER OR A NEW SCENE.
The uploaded photo is the source image and the only authority. The blue/dark drawn strokes define the exact character and objects. Turn THOSE SAME STROKES into solid, realistic forms. Do not use the drawing merely as a reference or inspiration. Do not replace the drawn figure with a generic person, child, toy, doll, superhero, or different character.

TRACE THE DRAWING FIRST:
Mentally trace every visible line in the uploaded image. Preserve the exact topology and geometry: which lines connect, where each line starts and ends, angles, curves, intersections, outline shapes, relative lengths, and spacing. Preserve the original number of subjects and objects. The head, hair/crown, eyes, mouth, torso, arms, hands, legs, and feet must follow the lines actually present. If the drawing shows a simple stick figure, keep its simple body structure; make the existing lines volumetric and realistic rather than inventing a detailed human body that changes the pose. If a house, car, animal, or other object is drawn, turn that exact outline into that object in place. Do not add an object unless its outline is actually visible in the source.

PIXEL/COMPOSITION LOCK:
Keep the paper, its texture, creases, lighting, and camera viewpoint. Keep the drawing in the same area of the frame and preserve the relative positions and sizes of all drawn items. The final scene must line up with the original sketch when overlaid: each transformed object should occupy the area defined by its source lines. Do not move the character to the centre if it is off-centre. Do not fill empty paper with a scene. Do not crop, reframe, or zoom dramatically. Keep the whole relevant drawing visible.

WHAT “BECOME REAL” MEANS:
The blue ink strokes slowly thicken into three-dimensional edges and surfaces. The shapes enclosed by the drawn outlines acquire believable material, volume, texture, depth, and realistic shadows. The character's identity and pose remain anchored to the original line drawing. Realism comes from lighting, surface detail, depth, and physical shading—not from adding new anatomy, clothes, accessories, props, or background scenery. Keep the original simple design recognizable. If a detail is not specified by the lines, keep it minimal and neutral instead of inventing a distinctive feature.

ANIMATE ONLY AFTER THE SHAPES ARE ESTABLISHED:
Once the exact drawn forms have become three-dimensional, add only tiny, physically plausible motion that does not alter the design: a slight head turn, gentle breathing, or a small movement of one existing limb if the drawn pose permits it. Keep houses and other nonliving objects stationary. Do not make the character run, jump, grab tools, drive, interact with new props, or perform a story action unless that action is explicitly shown in the drawing.

10-SECOND TIMELINE, ONE CONTINUOUS SHOT:
0–2 s: show the uploaded drawing exactly as it is, clearly visible on the paper.
2–6 s: the existing ink lines themselves rise from the page and turn into three-dimensional realistic forms, following the same outlines and connections.
6–8 s: realistic materials, depth, and shadows settle onto those same forms; all objects remain in their original positions.
8–10 s: subtle natural motion only; finish with the transformed scene still aligned to the source drawing.

CAMERA AND LOOK:
Fixed camera or extremely subtle push-in only. Preserve perspective and framing. Realistic materials, physically correct contact shadows, stable exposure, smooth gradual transformation. Vertical 9:16 portrait. The paper remains visible throughout. No cuts.

STRICTLY FORBIDDEN:
No new character; no generic child or toy; no redesigned face; no added clothing or accessories; no extra limbs or fingers; no added cars, tools, plants, grass, furniture, buildings, windows, props, scenery, or background; no moving objects to new locations; no omitted drawn objects; no duplicated objects; no object substitution; no dramatic camera move; no fantasy environment; no diorama; no random morphing, melting, flicker, or shape warping; no text, captions, logos, or watermark. Do not interpret blank paper as a request to invent a scene.

SUCCESS TEST:
The result should look like the original drawing has physically risen from the paper. A viewer should be able to match each realistic shape to the same line or outline in the input. Preserve the drawing first; realism is applied to its existing forms, not created by replacing them.

AUDIO: no narration or dialogue; no music; optional very subtle room ambience only.

nodes.title: EXACT SKETCH LINES TO REALITY — 10s

widgets_values:
Vaporwave title sequence look: pink and blue gradient palette, VHS tracking artifacts, Greek statue motifs, chrome palm trees, RGB chromatic aberration, lo-fi retro atmosphere, mood languid and nostalgic.

Timeline:
[0s-1s] VHS static opens the frame, the title "COMFYUI" appears with RGB split and a slight horizontal jitter.
[1s-2.5s] Hard cut, a Greek plaster bust close-up, pink-purple gradient sky, a pixelated sun.
[2.5s-4s] Clean "STARRING" credits appear, "LATENT" and "CONTROLNET" each shown exactly once.
[4s-5s] Final card "DIRECTED BY COMFYUI" holds, one VHS tracking glitch settling into stability.

Hard cuts only, transitions landing with tape jumps, no push-ins, no dissolves.

Audio: lo-fi vaporwave score, slow drum machine with soft bass, VHS tape-noise sample joins at 2.5s, melody fading for the last 1s.

All text must be clearly legible, do not misspell English, no Chinese characters, do not repeat names or job titles, no soft dissolves, no subtitle bars.

extra.mediaforge_concat_note: MediaForge MF_ConcatVideos. Uses the current known _00001_ scene files by absolute path. If you regenerate scenes and get _00002_ or later, update video_paths to those exact filenames. mode=transcode, 24 fps, 1280x736, H.264.
extra.workflow_note: VHS-only combine workflow. Phase 1: queue generation nodes with Phase 2 VHS nodes disabled. After the three MP4s are saved, disable generation nodes and enable VHS nodes (mode 0), then queue again. VHS loader/merge nodes process frame batches and Video Combine encodes the merged frames. Original audio tracks are not wired.

dino_pals_batch.note: Single ComfyUI workflow graph for Episodes 03-10. Each episode includes a generated 5-second title intro plus 15 connected story scenes. Episode 04-10 opening references depend on the previous episode final scene output.
